Six everyday seats; eight to ten for occasional dining
1800–2800 × 1000 mm table. Occupied seating shown. Green dots mark connected approaches for a 600 mm body.
Pulling out an end chair temporarily narrows passing space. Four folding chairs and two extension leaves store in the sideboard.
